method: Arb ball arithmetic; half-plane argument principle on bisected boundary pieces
statement: Each listed disc contains exactly one zero of zeta, on the critical line and simple. These 1517 zeros and their conjugates are all the zeros of zeta in [-1, 2] x [-2000, 2000], so every zero with 0 < Im s < 2000 is on the critical line and simple.
scope: tau = 0 only. Finite height: nothing is claimed above Im s = 2000. Not a proof of the Riemann hypothesis.
